chunks: Ahmad ibn Idris, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Kufi, from Ubeys ibn Hisham, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I said to him, 'A man was captured by the Romans and did not fast the month of Ramadan, and he did not know which month it was.' He said: 'He should fast a month, and he should envisage and calculate. So if the month he fasted was before the month of Ramadan, it would not suffice him; and if it was after Ramadan, it would suffice him.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for someone who missed Ramadan fasting due to captivity and lost track of the months?
ai.summary: This ruling from al-Kafi highlights the Shia principle of 'ihtiyat' (precaution) combined with 'yusr' (ease), where the captive's obligation is satisfied if they fast a month that likely encompasses Ramadan, based on their best calculation. Scholars note this reflects the practical reality of lunar calendar uncertainty for those isolated from communal religious life, emphasizing that the intent and reasonable effort suffice when precise tracking is impossible. It underscores the flexibility in fiqh regarding missed obligations due to genuine incapacity.

en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Idrees, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Kufy, from Ubeys Bin Hisham, from Aban Bin Usman, 
(It has been narrated) from Abdul Rahman son of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A man was captured by the Romans and did not Fast the Month of Ramazan, and he did not know which month it was’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He should Fast a month, and he should envisage and calculate. So if it was such that the month he Fasted in was before the Month of Ramazan, it would not suffice him; and if it was such that it was after the Month of Ramazan, it would suffice him’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ahmad ibn Idris has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Ali al-Kufiy from ‘Ubays ibn Hisham from Aban ibn ‘Uthman from ‘Abd al- Rahman who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,

about a man who was captured by the Romans, and he did not fast in the month of Ramadan because he did not know which month was it. He (the Imam) said, ‘He is required to fast for one month. He then tries to calculate; if the month that he has fasted is before the month of Ramadan; it is not sufficient, and if it is after the month of Ramadan, it is then sufficient.’”
